status: Locked before training and season runs; retrospective with no untouched holdout
mixture: P(Y>=8)*E[Y|Y>=8] + (1-P(Y>=8))*E[Y|Y<8]; HGB classifier and two conditional HGB regressors, same BASE+FX, previous seasons only
future_forecasts: No future game rows or final future schedule. One neutral fixture per future round. Current per-fixture forecast decays toward neutral forecast with 0.5^k. Blank current round uses neutral level. Neutral home=.5, opponent mean predeadline league rating/GA from currently eligible clubs. Frozen current player features and prices.
optimizer: Rolling horizon integer program: separate squads, XI, captain, buys, sells, cash and exact capped FT transitions per planned round. Reoptimize each actual deadline; execute first action only. Same candidate pool union based on current/mean forecast, cheap/value players and all owned for BOTH horizons. No player can be bought more than once or sold more than once within a plan; initially owned players cannot be rebought. Current purchase/selling price accounting exact under frozen prices.
chips: Original fixed calendar or none. Truncate horizon before a future wildcard/free hit. Current free hit uses one round; current wildcard preserves FT. Future BB/TC known from policy calendar. End at GW38.
objective: Sum planned expected XI + captain + 0.1 bench points, minus 4 per paid transfer and 0.5 per ordinary transfer. No discount or terminal value. Actual net season points primary.
comparisons: H4-H1 within each forecast model; mixture-HGB at each horizon; difference-in-differences; all against strong reference H1. Legacy baseline reported separately if candidate pool changes decisions.
limits: Neutral future scenarios, not archived fixture-aware forecasts
No new minute model; existing lagged minute features retained
Final current-GW assignment remains inherited proxy
No post-result parameter search; no automatic production promotion
numeric_control: Refitted ridge/extra may differ at float32 rounding scale: require <1e-5, then reuse existing current-round forecasts exactly. Neutral predictions use refitted models.
